name: All done empty state
summary: Inbox zero: a calm note that everything is handled, when new items will show up, and a quiet way to see what's done.
use: when a person has finished every item in a queue, inbox or to-do list
a11y: The heading says the state in words; the check drawing is decorative and hidden from screen readers.

use_when: a queue, inbox or review list has been cleared by the person
avoid_when: the list has never had items: use empty-first-use
items are hidden by a filter: use empty-filtered
keyboard: Tab reaches See what you approved

empty.how: This part is the empty state itself.

loading.how: Not applicable: shown instead of content, after loading has failed or been refused.

error.how: Not applicable: an error isn't an empty list. Use page-banners or page-error.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

missing_image.how: The part has no picture; its drawing is an inline icon.
